author: Sanjeev Bhandari
review_text: Very bad service. Very bad customer service. I have tried to contact them for resetting password. Now always I get multiple login temporary lock for 60 min. Even after 60 min I cannot reset password. I tried multiple times I am prompted to send messages. But reply is OTP but when I exit it to type OTP the page goes to login. Also for customer ticket service no OTP has been received by me. 😞 Poor customer service.
